register.heading: Register
register.backButtonLabel: Already have an account? Log in
register.usernameDescription: Username must be unique and between 3 and 20 characters
register.emailDescription: We'll use this email to contact you
register.passwordDescription: Password must be at least 8 characters long
register.successAlertTitle: Enter the token in the input field
register.successAlertDescription: Get the token from the database, from the Token entity under the VERIFY_EMAIL type. Or copy it from the server console if it's running in development mode.

verify.heading: Verify Account
verify.tokenDescription: Enter the token from the DB (or from the server console)
verify.successMessage: Your account has been successfully verified.
verify.errorMessage: An error occurred during account verification.

login.heading: Log in to your account
login.pinDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authentication app
login.errorMessage: Invalid login credentials. Please try again.

resetPassword.heading: Reset Password
resetPassword.emailDescription: Your email that you used during registration
resetPassword.successAlertDescription: Check your email for instructions on how to reset your password.
resetPassword.errorMessage: An error occurred while resetting the password.

newPassword.heading: New Password
newPassword.passwordDescription: Enter a new password (at least 8 characters)
newPassword.passwordRepeatDescription: Repeat the new password to confirm
newPassword.successMessage: Your password has been successfully updated. You can now log in with your new password.
newPassword.errorMessage: An error occurred while setting the new password.
